nl: Run tools/job.py once for each of the names n1, n2, n3, n4, all at the same time in the background. When all have finished, write their output lines sorted to summary-3.txt. Leave no other files behind.

entries.content_utf8:
import sys
import time

time.sleep(0.3)
print(f"{sys.argv[1]} done")

oracle_program:
run ["python3", "tools/job.py", "n1"] background: true label: "n1"
run ["python3", "tools/job.py", "n2"] background: true label: "n2"
run ["python3", "tools/job.py", "n3"] background: true label: "n3"
run ["python3", "tools/job.py", "n4"] background: true label: "n4"
jobs wait: 60s |> select stdout |> sort text |> write "summary-3.txt"
reference_bash:
mkdir -p out
python3 tools/job.py n1 > out/n1.txt &
python3 tools/job.py n2 > out/n2.txt &
python3 tools/job.py n3 > out/n3.txt &
python3 tools/job.py n4 > out/n4.txt &
wait
sort out/*.txt > summary-3.txt
rm -r out
